Subject: Inquiry: Compliance add-ons & pilot pricing

Hi Ava,

We're evaluating Redwood for a pilot of document processing and care-routing features. Security/compliance are make-or-break for procurement: we need HIPAA controls, EU residency for a subset of workloads, and a managed KMS/HSM option (attested). We also want detailed audit logging with at-rest retention options and the ability to stream logs to our SIEM.

Can you send a modular price sheet (recurring vs one-time) for:
- Audit log retention tiers (30/90/365 days) + per-GB storage/export fees
- Managed KMS/HSM (per-seat vs per-key licensing; attestation options)
- Data residency (EU region enforced + cross-region failover pricing)
- Any onboarding/onetime compliance uplift fees (e.g., SOC2 evidence package, custom attestations)

We're aiming to kick off a 3-month pilot with ~500k tokens/month and a small production pilot on EU data. Procurement will need PO-ready numbers by Oct 7. Budget for add-ons is constrained. If Redwood can offer pilot credits or a temporary discount on compliance add-ons, that will help speed approval.

Attaching our security questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,
Natalie Ruiz
Security Lead, ClearPath Medical

Quick answers up front:
- KMS/HSM: we support both managed KMS seats (customer keys managed by Redwood) and an HSM-backed option for FIPS-level key storage. Pricing can be quoted per-seat (managed) or per-attested-HSM-instance for customers who require dedicated hardware.
- Audit logs: retention tiers with per-GB storage for long-term retention + export/streaming add-on to ship to your SIEM.
- Residency: EU region is available; cross-region failover (active-passive) is an add-on and can be scoped with RTO/RPO targets.

I'm attaching a short pricing table with a modular breakdown so you can see recurring vs one-time line items. Proposed pilot concession: 3 months of 50% off compliance add-on fees (audit log storage + KMS seats) or alternatively a one-time compliance credit equal to one month of expected add-on spend — whichever helps procurement quicker.

I'll loop in Marissa (sales lead) and Ben (solutions) on the next message to confirm constraints and finalize numbers.

Next steps: I'll send a clearly itemized quote + draft pilot SOW by EOD tomorrow. Does procurement require a specific invoice/PO format?

Best,

Hi Natalie — looping Marissa and Ben to confirm commercial flexibility and technical scoping.

Marissa / Ben, see Natalie's questions below and the attached breakdown. My suggested concrete options to close procurement quickly:

Option A — Pilot bundle (minimal upfront):
- 3-month pilot: 50% off recurring compliance add-ons (audit log storage + KMS seats) OR a one-time compliance credit equal to one month of projected add-on spend (their choice).
- Audit logs: 30-day retention included in pilot at no additional storage charge. Extended retention tiers: 90d = $0.03/GB/mo, 365d = $0.08/GB/mo.
- KMS/HSM: Managed KMS seat: $1,200/seat/mo (includes key rotation + monthly attestation report). Dedicated HSM instance (single-tenant): $7,500/instance/mo (attestation included; provisioning lead time 4–6 weeks).
- Audit export: streaming to SIEM is an add-on integration ($1,500 one-time) + $0.01/GB egress for exports beyond 100GB/mo.
- Residency: EU enforcement available via regional tenant; no cross-border processing for the named workload if pinned to EU-tenant (additional $0.02/GB for EU storage delta).
- Onboarding: standard onboarding fee $6,000; for Pilot bundle we can either 1) amortize fee across pilot as a credit, or 2) waive onboarding if they sign a 12-month committed spend on hosted inference.

Option B — Enterprise commitment (reduced unit cost):
- 12-month commitment: 20% off all compliance add-on recurring charges; KMS seats drop to $950/seat/mo; dedicated HSM $6,000/instance/mo; onboarding waived.

Attachments: pilot_statement_of_work_v1.docx (SOW template) and the pricing table already shared.

I captured the specific asks on key rotation/attestation (included for managed seats), streaming (one-time integration + per-GB beyond threshold), and EU residency (regional tenant to guarantee no cross-border processing). Procurement format: we can provide an invoice-ready quote (line-item CSV) and will accept PO. DocuSign link to pilot SOW can be provided once terms are agreed.

Ava

Thanks for the clear options, Ava. A couple guardrails from commercial:
- Pilot discount: we can authorize up to 40% off compliance add-ons for a 3-month pilot without additional approvals. 50% requires either a written exception from Sales Leadership or conversion language (a mutual action plan with a forward-looking 12-month commit).
- Onboarding fee: we prefer to offer a waiver or a one-time onboarding credit rather than amortizing; waive only if they sign 12-month commitment. Otherwise we can apply a $3,000 credit toward onboarding that reduces the initial PO.
- HSM pricing: dedicated HSM instances are capacity-constrained; if they need guaranteed instance availability for the pilot we should include a 4–6 week lead time note in the SOW.

Operational ask: Ben, please flag any technical reasons we can't guarantee no cross-border processing in a shared tenancy. If it's impossible without a dedicated tenant, we should state that explicitly to avoid procurement surprises.

I'll approve the 40% pilot add-on discount and the $3k onboarding credit if needed. Ava, go ahead and send an invoice-ready line-item quote and the DocuSign SOW link; Natalie needs numbers by Oct 7.

Marissa Co le
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
